features.name: payment_mix_hhi_7d
features.definition: Herfindahl-Hirschman index (sum of squared GMV-weighted payment-method shares) over trailing 7d. Higher = more concentrated in one method.

features.name: payment_mix_hhi_28d
features.definition: Herfindahl-Hirschman index (sum of squared GMV-weighted payment-method shares) over trailing 28d. Higher = more concentrated in one method.

features.name: payment_mix_hhi_60d
features.definition: Herfindahl-Hirschman index (sum of squared GMV-weighted payment-method shares) over trailing 60d. Higher = more concentrated in one method.

features.name: payment_mix_l1_drift_7v28
features.definition: Sum of |share_i(7d) - share_i(28d)| across payment methods — how much the mix has moved recently vs. the medium-term.

features.name: payment_mix_l1_drift_28v60
features.definition: Sum of |share_i(28d) - share_i(60d)| across payment methods — medium-term vs. long-term mix drift.

features.name: refund_rate_7d
features.definition: Volume-weighted refund rate over trailing 7d: sum(refund_count)/sum(transaction_count). Not a mean of daily rates, to avoid low-count distortion.

features.name: refund_rate_28d
features.definition: Volume-weighted refund rate over trailing 28d: sum(refund_count)/sum(transaction_count). Not a mean of daily rates, to avoid low-count distortion.

features.name: refund_rate_60d
features.definition: Volume-weighted refund rate over trailing 60d: sum(refund_count)/sum(transaction_count). Not a mean of daily rates, to avoid low-count distortion.

features.name: refund_amount_to_gmv_28d
features.definition: Dollar-weighted refund burden: sum(refund_amount)/sum(gmv) over trailing 28d.

features.name: refund_count_28d
features.definition: Raw refund count over trailing 28d — exposure/confidence context for refund_rate_28d (a rate from 2 refunds is far less reliable than one from 50).

features.name: chargeback_rate_7d
features.definition: Volume-weighted chargeback rate over trailing 7d: sum(chargeback_count)/sum(transaction_count).

features.name: chargeback_rate_28d
features.definition: Volume-weighted chargeback rate over trailing 28d: sum(chargeback_count)/sum(transaction_count).

features.name: chargeback_rate_60d
features.definition: Volume-weighted chargeback rate over trailing 60d: sum(chargeback_count)/sum(transaction_count).

features.name: chargeback_amount_to_gmv_28d
features.definition: Dollar-weighted chargeback exposure: sum(chargeback_amount)/sum(gmv) over trailing 28d.

features.name: chargeback_count_28d
features.definition: Raw chargeback count over trailing 28d — exposure/confidence context for chargeback_rate_28d.

features.name: days_since_last_chargeback
features.definition: Days since the most recent day (<=t) with chargeback_count>0 for this merchant, capped at 90. A recency signal that doesn't collapse to 0 on days with no observed chargebacks yet.

features.name: fulfillment_on_time_rate_7d
features.definition: Transaction-volume-weighted mean of fulfillment_on_time_rate over trailing 7d.

features.name: fulfillment_on_time_rate_28d
features.definition: Transaction-volume-weighted mean of fulfillment_on_time_rate over trailing 28d.

features.name: fulfillment_on_time_rate_60d
features.definition: Transaction-volume-weighted mean of fulfillment_on_time_rate over trailing 60d.

features.name: fulfillment_delay_avg_days_28d
features.definition: Transaction-volume-weighted mean fulfillment delay (days) over trailing 28d.

features.name: new_customer_rate_7d
features.definition: Volume-weighted new-customer share over trailing 7d: sum(new_customers)/sum(customer_count).

features.name: new_customer_rate_28d
features.definition: Volume-weighted new-customer share over trailing 28d: sum(new_customers)/sum(customer_count).

features.name: new_customer_rate_60d
features.definition: Volume-weighted new-customer share over trailing 60d: sum(new_customers)/sum(customer_count).

features.name: customer_count_28d
features.definition: Mean daily distinct customer count over trailing 28d — activity scale context.

features.name: liquidity_balance_28d
features.definition: Mean daily liquidity_balance over trailing 28d (same units as gmv).

features.name: liquidity_to_gmv_ratio_28d
features.definition: liquidity_balance_28d / mean(gmv, 28d) — buffer expressed as 'days of current GMV', directly interpretable.

features.name: pending_settlement_to_gmv_28d
features.definition: mean(pending_settlement_amount, 28d) / mean(gmv, 28d) — settlement pipeline scale relative to volume.

features.name: liquidity_coefficient_of_variation_28d
features.definition: std(liquidity_balance, 28d) / mean(liquidity_balance, 28d) — how stable the buffer has been recently.

features.name: gmv_level_28d
features.definition: Mean daily gmv over trailing 28d.

features.name: transaction_count_level_28d
features.definition: Mean daily transaction_count over trailing 28d.

features.name: gmv_coefficient_of_variation_28d
features.definition: std(gmv, 28d) / mean(gmv, 28d) — the merchant's own day-to-day noisiness, context for interpreting other deviations.

features.name: merchant_tenure_days
features.definition: date - signup_date, in days. A real business-facing attribute (account age), not a generator ground-truth risk parameter — the only merchants.csv-derived feature in this pipeline.

features.name: is_weekend
features.definition: 1 if the observation date is Saturday/Sunday, else 0.

features.name: day_of_year_sin
features.definition: sin(2*pi*day_of_year/365.25) — cyclical calendar position, lets a model account for seasonality explicitly.

features.name: day_of_year_cos
features.definition: cos(2*pi*day_of_year/365.25) — paired with day_of_year_sin for a non-discontinuous yearly cycle encoding.

features.name: chargeback_rate_velocity_7v28
features.definition: chargeback_rate(7d) - chargeback_rate(28d) — short-term momentum (percentage points).

features.name: chargeback_rate_velocity_28v60
features.definition: chargeback_rate(28d) - chargeback_rate(60d) — medium-term momentum (percentage points).

features.name: chargeback_rate_acceleration
features.definition: velocity_7v28 - velocity_28v60 — is short-term momentum itself increasing (acceleration) or fading?

features.name: refund_rate_velocity_7v28
features.definition: refund_rate(7d) - refund_rate(28d) — short-term momentum (percentage points).

features.name: refund_rate_velocity_28v60
features.definition: refund_rate(28d) - refund_rate(60d) — medium-term momentum (percentage points).

features.name: refund_rate_acceleration
features.definition: velocity_7v28 - velocity_28v60 — is short-term momentum itself increasing (acceleration) or fading?

features.name: fulfillment_on_time_rate_velocity_7v28
features.definition: fulfillment_on_time_rate(7d) - fulfillment_on_time_rate(28d) — short-term momentum (percentage points).

features.name: fulfillment_on_time_rate_velocity_28v60
features.definition: fulfillment_on_time_rate(28d) - fulfillment_on_time_rate(60d) — medium-term momentum (percentage points).

features.name: fulfillment_on_time_rate_acceleration
features.definition: velocity_7v28 - velocity_28v60 — is short-term momentum itself increasing (acceleration) or fading?

features.name: gmv_velocity_7v28
features.definition: mean(gmv,7d)/mean(gmv,28d) - 1 — relative GMV growth, short vs medium term.

features.name: gmv_velocity_28v60
features.definition: mean(gmv,28d)/mean(gmv,60d) - 1 — relative GMV growth, medium vs long term.

features.name: gmv_acceleration
features.definition: gmv_velocity_7v28 - gmv_velocity_28v60 — is GMV growth speeding up or slowing down?

features.name: transaction_count_velocity_7v28
features.definition: mean(transaction_count,7d)/mean(transaction_count,28d) - 1.

features.name: new_customer_rate_velocity_7v28
features.definition: new_customer_rate(7d) - new_customer_rate(28d).

features.name: chargeback_rate_deviation_z
features.definition: (current 7d chargeback_rate - this merchant's own expanding-history mean of its 28d chargeback_rate) / expanding std, clipped to [-10,10]. Uses only this merchant's own day_index<=t history.

features.name: refund_rate_deviation_z
features.definition: (current 7d refund_rate - this merchant's own expanding-history mean of its 28d refund_rate) / expanding std, clipped to [-10,10]. Uses only this merchant's own day_index<=t history.

features.name: gmv_deviation_z
features.definition: (current 7d gmv - this merchant's own expanding-history mean of its 28d gmv) / expanding std, clipped to [-10,10]. Uses only this merchant's own day_index<=t history.

features.name: fulfillment_on_time_rate_deviation_z
features.definition: (current 7d fulfillment_on_time_rate - this merchant's own expanding-history mean of its 28d fulfillment_on_time_rate) / expanding std, clipped to [-10,10]. Uses only this merchant's own day_index<=t history.

features.name: new_customer_rate_deviation_z
features.definition: (current 7d new_customer_rate - this merchant's own expanding-history mean of its 28d new_customer_rate) / expanding std, clipped to [-10,10]. Uses only this merchant's own day_index<=t history.

features.name: liquidity_deviation_z
features.definition: (current 7d liquidity_balance - this merchant's own expanding-history mean of its 28d liquidity_balance) / expanding std, clipped to [-10,10].

leakage_guarantees: Only merchants.csv[merchant_id, signup_date] and daily_observations.csv were read.
events.csv and labels.csv were never loaded by this pipeline.
Every feature is a trailing (ending at t, inclusive) or expanding (day_index<=t) function.
